pages.title: Ministry of the Interior (Greece) - Wikipedia
pages.excerpt: The**Ministry of the Interior**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Εσωτερικών) is a[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece). On 15 September 1995, it was merged with the Ministry of the Prime Minister's Office (Υπουργείο Προεδρίας της Κυβέρνησης) to form the**Ministry of the Interior, Public Administration and Decentralization**(Υπουργείο Εσωτερικών, Δημόσιας Διοίκησης και Αποκέντρωσης). On 19 September 2007, it was merged with the[Ministry of Public Order](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Citizen_Protection_(Greece))and reverted to its original name. The merger was reversed on 7 October 2009, when the**Ministry of the Interior, Decentralization and Electronic Governance**(Υπουργείο Εσωτερικών, Αποκέντρωσης και Ηλεκτρονικής Διακυβέρνησης) was formed.
